title: Finiteness of cohomology of a sheaf of modules on a curve is preserved by finite pushforwards
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that finiteness of the cohomology of a sheaf of Lambda-modules on a separated curve of dimension at most one is preserved by a finite pushforward (statement lines 15908-15916). The proof (proof lines 15918-15924) uses the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism and the Leray spectral sequence to identify the two cohomology groups and transfers finiteness. H2: one identification plus one transfer.
